summary: This is an 8-K filed by Vireo Growth Inc. reporting a share consolidation approved at its annual meeting and board meeting. The board set a 30-for-1 consolidation ratio effective June 5, 2026. The subordinate voting shares continue trading on CSE under VREO and OTCQX under VREOF with new ISIN/CUSIP. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. Share consolidations are typically used to meet listing standards or reduce share count; there is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review disclosed.
